name: Worldforged Cord of Living Vines in Un'Goro rests on the ground and opens (#10694)
contract: #10694 reports the Cord of Living Vines pickup missing in Un'Goro. Its gameobject 96219 (guid 6941583, loot item 515396) was spawned at z -270.602, under the ground surface at its x, y: the floor found from 3 yd above is -268.59, 1.71 yd over the box (spawn_headroom 1.71, spawn_ground_gap -1.29 against the terrain under it, worldserver map/vmap data). The pickup now rests on that surface with nothing over it and opens with the Opening cast 3365 from 1.5 yd away.
